items.title: Tesla Stock Rises But a 5-Day Win Streak Would Mask Risks
items.summary: Tesla  stock was on track to notch a five-session winning streak on Wednesday, but that doesn’t mean the electric-vehicle maker has turned a corner following a rough stretch.  Tesla stock has closed in the green for four straight trading days, rising 4.2% over that period.

items.summary: Ron Baron turned a $400 million Tesla position into $7.7 billion in profit when Wall Street laughed him out of the room, and now he is making an even larger bet on a company he believes will reshape the economics of an entire planet.
